description: This file contains utility functions related to voice wake command processing, including normalization of tokens, trigger phrase detection, and command extraction based on wake words and triggers.

methods.name: normalizeToken
methods.description: Normalizes a token by trimming whitespace and punctuation, then converting to lowercase.

methods.name: startsWithTrigger
methods.description: Checks if the transcript starts with any of the specified trigger phrases.

methods.name: textOnlyCommand
methods.description: Extracts a command string from the transcript if it passes trigger and length checks.
